> When customers ask ChatGPT, Google AI or Perplexity who to hire, is your business the answer? Measure your AI Visibility Score, track recommendations daily, and get a prioritized roadmap to become the business AI recommends.

## Blog

- [GEO, AI search visibility, and what actually moves them](https://echorank360.com/en/blog): Practical writing on generative engine optimization: how to measure AI visibility, how to earn citations, and which of your SEO habits still apply. Method…
- [AI Crawler User-Agents & robots.txt Guide](https://echorank360.com/en/blog/ai-crawler-user-agents-and-robots-txt): GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and friends do different jobs. Blocking the wrong one removes you from answers, not just from training.
- [How to Find and Close Your AI Citation Gap](https://echorank360.com/en/blog/find-your-ai-citation-gap): A citation gap is the distance between how often AI answers mention you and how often they cite you. Here is how to measure it and what actually closes it.
- [How to Measure AI Search Visibility](https://echorank360.com/en/blog/how-to-measure-ai-search-visibility): AI search visibility is measured by running a fixed prompt set on a schedule and recording four things: coverage, citation share, position and framing.
- [Make Your Site Readable to AI Crawlers](https://echorank360.com/en/blog/make-your-site-readable-to-ai-crawlers): AI crawlers do not run your JavaScript, and many are blocked by a robots.txt nobody has read since 2021. Check access and rendering before writing more content.
- [Schema Markup for AI Answers & GEO](https://echorank360.com/en/blog/schema-markup-for-ai-answers): Schema will not make a model understand your page, but it decides how retrieval pipelines classify it. The types that pull weight for AI visibility.
- [SEO Metrics vs GEO Metrics: What Carries Over](https://echorank360.com/en/blog/seo-vs-geo-metrics): Rankings, impressions and CTR describe a ranked list. AI answers have no list. Here is which SEO metrics still work in GEO, which mislead, and what replaces…
- [Structure Content for AI Answers (GEO Patterns)](https://echorank360.com/en/blog/structure-content-for-ai-answers): Answer engines quote passages, not pages. Answer-first sections, self-contained passages and concrete claims are what turn content into citations.
- [Track Brand Mentions Across LLMs](https://echorank360.com/en/blog/track-brand-mentions-across-llms): A repeatable method for monitoring how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity describe your brand: fixed prompts, clean sessions, scheduled weekly runs.
- [llms.txt: What It Is and What It Is Not](https://echorank360.com/en/blog/what-llms-txt-is-and-is-not): llms.txt is a proposed convention, not a standard and not an access control. Here is what it can do, what it cannot, and how to write one worth having.
